title: Jeremy Renner Says ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Superheroes ‘Will Probably Lose’ Without Hawkeye: ‘They Didn’t Call Me, So It’s Their Fault’
description: The full list of MCU characters who will appear in “Avengers: Doomsday” may still be a mystery, but Jeremy Renner has made it clear he didn’t return
body:
The full list of MCU characters who will appear in “Avengers: Doomsday” may still be a mystery, but Jeremy Renner has made it clear he didn’t return as Hawkeye — and says The Avengers “will probably lose” as a result.

	“No, no, no, no. Not in that one,” said Renner when asked if he was returning for “Doomsday” in a recent interview. “’Doomsday’ I’m not in, so the Avengers will probably lose, just so you know… they didn’t call me, so it’s their fault. They’re going to lose.”
	

	Though he isn’t reprising the role of Hawkeye for “Doomsday,” the actor did note that he was excited about the re-release of “Avengers: Endgame,” which brought the 2019 film back to theaters ahead of “Doomsday’s” Dec. 18 release. Renner has played the superhero previously in “The Avengers,” “Avengers: Age of Ultron” and “Endgame,” in addition to other films like “Thor” and “Captain America: Civil War,” in which he made brief appearances. 


	In 2025, Renner said that he was open to returning to the MCU, whether it was for Season 2 of “Hawkeye” or something else. “I’m always happy to be in that world, man. I love all those guys, I love the character,” Renner told Empire. “I’m sure we’ll end up doing Season 2 [of ‘Hawkeye’], and do other things. And I’m happy to do it. My body’s getting ready for something like that. I don’t know if anybody wants to see me in tights, but my body will look good in the tights.”

	At the time, he’d also noted that he’d recovered “more than 150%” from his 2023 snowmobile accident, meaning he was ready to do his own stunts for the Marvel films. Renner had been hospitalized after his Sno-Cat, a large snow plow that weighs at least 14,330 pounds, ran him over, resulting in eight of his ribs being broken in 14 places, his right knee and ankle broken, left leg tibia broken, left ankle broken, right clavicle broken, right shoulder broken and more.

schema.headline: Jeremy Renner Says ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Superheroes ‘Will Probably Lose’ Without Hawkeye: ‘They Didn’t Call Me, So It’s Their Fault’

title: Toni Collette’s Directorial Debut ‘The Best Of’ Among 75 Projects Backed by Screen Australia
description: Toni Collette will make her feature directing debut with “The Best Of,” her screen version of Graeme Simsion’s bestselling novel, which is one of 75
body:
Toni Collette will make her feature directing debut with “The Best Of,” her screen version of Graeme Simsion’s bestselling novel, which is one of 75 projects sharing more than AUD16.9 million ($11.7 million) in production and development money from Screen Australia.

	Collette, an Emmy and Golden Globe winner, produces alongside Christopher Simon. The story centers on two ex-lovers who come back into each other’s lives after spending decades apart, only to find old feelings stirring with messy and mixed results. Screen Australia made a major production investment in association with Screen NSW. Kismet handles local distribution and Cornerstone holds international sales.
	

	The round, announced Tuesday, covers features, series and shorts.


	“Australian storytellers continue to captivate audiences with their creativity, originality and distinctive perspectives. This latest round of funding supports an exciting range of projects from emerging creatives forging new paths to established voices exploring new creative territory. Screen Currency 2026 found that local stories matter deeply to Australians, and these projects will deliver on the authenticity and ambition that audiences have come to expect,” said Louise Gough, Screen Australia’s director of narrative content.

	Brouhaha Entertainment, the company behind “Boy Swallows Universe,” is making “The Dark Lake,” a series based on Sarah Bailey’s award-winning novel. Tonkin plays a detective in a rural town whose investigation into the killing of a former high school classmate forces her to face buried secrets of her own. Troy Lum and Andrew Mason produce, with Becca Johnstone writing and executive producing. Giorgia Stawaruk, Tonkin and Katarina Mandic are also executive producers. Screenwest partners on the major production investment, with additional financing from Screen NSW.
	

	Jeffrey Walker (“The Artful Dodger,” “Fing!”) directs “Bull” (working title), a feature from Infin8 Studios and Total Fiction Films. Drawn from a true story, it follows a smooth-talking prisoner who signs up for a debating team inside Tasmania’s harshest jail, hoping to change course and finally give his mother a reason to be proud. George Pullar stars, co-writes with Taylor Danworth and produces with Michael Lawrence, John Molloy and Suzanne Walker. Richard Roxburgh, Robyn Malcolm, Teresa Palmer, Thomas M Wright and Harrison Gilbertson round out the cast. Screen Queensland is on board, with Kismet distributing locally and Cornerstone handling international sales.

	Sooshi Mango’s untitled feature debut follows three obstinate Italian immigrants who mobilize their multicultural neighborhood when a mysterious wellness club puts their cherished social club at risk. Nick Kozakis (“Kick On”) directs from a script by the group’s Joe Salanitri, Carlo Salanitri and Andrew Manfre with Declan Fay. Paul Dainty and Cathy Rodda produce, with Timothy Whiting as co-producer. VicScreen partners, and Roadshow has local distribution.

	Rodd Rathjen directs “No Friend But the Mountains,” adapted from Behrouz Boochani’s acclaimed memoir, from a screenplay he co-wrote with Boochani. The Kurdish journalist, fleeing persecution, is intercepted at sea and sent to Manus Island, where he documents the gradual breakdown of the men held there. Gal Greenspan, Sharlene George, Amy Parry, Arkos Armont, Katy Roberts, Boochani and Antony Waddington produce. The New Zealand Film Commission, Screen Queensland and VicScreen are partners, with Madman distributing in Australia.

	On the development side, Mithila Gupta’s “Desi Down Under” will turn her coming-of-age Indian-Australian audio series into a romantic comedy feature about three misfits who head from Kerala to the beach at Coogee, where they hope to pick up surf-lifesaving skills they can use to help their compatriots. Gupta writes and produces with Nina Aujla, Smriti Mundhra and Maya Gnyp.

	Goalpost Pictures’ series “The Caretaker,” adapted from Gabriel Bergmoser’s bestselling novel by Alexei Mizin and Ryan van Dijk, both members of Screen Australia’s 2026 Talent Gateway cohort, also landed development backing. The thriller centers on a woman hiding out as caretaker of a ski resort out of season, who goes to ever more extreme lengths to hold on to the life she has built.
	

	Among the shorts, BAFTA-nominated Rosie Westhoff (“The Main Part”) writes and directs “Solastalgia,” in which a young girl tries to reassemble scattered memories of the bushfire that destroyed her home while looking for connection in a transformed place. Chloe Brennan (“We Used to Own Houses”), Amanda Browne and Ashlee Russell (both “Mothmama”) produce, with Kitty Green (“The Royal Hotel”) as mentor.

	Green also mentors the team behind a family short from Pasifika-led Mana Film Productions that mixes live action and animation, “My Life as a 12-Year-Old Demon Hunter… With Great Hair!” It tracks 12-year-old Tala over a single day as she fends off demons out to steal her powers – a bigger headache than her homework. AWGIE winner and bestselling author Maria Lewis writes, directs and co-produces, with Shonee Samia co-producing and Herbert Leota animating. Animator Jake Duczynski (“Magic Beach”) joins Green as mentor. Both shorts received principal production funding.

	Full lists of production, development and short film approvals are on Screen Australia’s website. The agency will reveal more recently funded projects alongside the ABC Media Showcase on Oct. 21.

schema.headline: Toni Collette’s Directorial Debut ‘The Best Of’ Among 75 Projects Backed by Screen Australia

title: Selma Blair Charged with Second-Degree Assault Following Plane Incident, Released on $20,000 Bail
description: Selma Blair has been charged with second-degree assault after being arrested following a violent incident on a Delta flight on Sunday, according to
body:
Selma Blair has been charged with second-degree assault after being arrested following a violent incident on a Delta flight on Sunday, according to Queens Criminal Court. The actress posted $20,000 in bail, paid by credit card, and was released on Monday. 

	Following her removal from the Delta plane on Sunday, the “Cruel Intentions” actress was arrested on Monday by a Port Authority police officer after allegedly attacking an officer and a nurse, per TMZ. She then appeared in Queens Criminal Court Monday evening, where she appeared before Judge Indira D. Khan, per court documents viewed by Variety. 
	

	On the plane, she allegedly punched one flight attendant and bit another while heading from Los Angeles to New York. Blair also attempted to open the plane door while in the air. Law enforcement was waiting for the 54-year-old “Legally Blonde” actress at John F. Kennedy airport, where police took her into custody and transported her to a hospital for evaluation. Two flight attendants reported injuries, with one receiving treatment at a hospital.


	After the incident, a representative for Blair told Variety: “Selma experienced a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct. Upon landing, she received immediate medical attention and is currently in stable condition.”

	In 2016, Blair experienced a previous outburst while on a plane, during which she was removed from a flight on a stretcher while traveling with her then 4-year-old son after she “had a total psychotic blackout,” as she described it. Blair attributed the incident to drinking a glass of wine and taking a pill. “It was horrible and frightening, and I had empathy for myself actually afterward because it was actually so out of character for me, especially because I’m a mother,” she said at the time.

schema.headline: Selma Blair Charged with Second-Degree Assault Following Plane Incident, Released on $20,000 Bail

title: ‘Other Mommy’ Nips ‘Verity’ in Photo Finish for U.K., Ireland Box Office Summit
description: Universal’s horror entry “Other Mommy,” directed by Rob Savage and starring Jessica Chastain and Jay Duplass, squeaked to the top of the U.K. and Ir
body:
Universal’s horror entry “Other Mommy,” directed by Rob Savage and starring Jessica Chastain and Jay Duplass, squeaked to the top of the U.K. and Ireland box office in a dead heat, debuting at No. 1 with £1.97 million ($2.66 million).

	The horror debut narrowly edged Sony’s psychological thriller “Verity,” which moved to second place in its sophomore session by a razor-thin margin of just £33,263 ($43,970), collecting £1.94 million ($2.62 million). The Colleen Hoover adaptation lifted its running cume to £7.3 million ($9.8 million).
	

	Paramount’s action thriller “Heart of the Beast,” starring Brad Pitt and J.K. Simmons, held third position in its third frame with $1.1 million, elevating its gross to $7.3 million. Sony’s franchise reboot “Resident Evil” took fourth spot in its fourth session, generating $1 million to advance its total to $17.1 million. Sony also claimed fifth position with the debut of Aaron Sorkin’s political drama “The Social Reckoning,” which collected $840,538.


	Universal’s “Sense and Sensibility” followed in sixth place during its third weekend, adding $797,038 for a running total of $6.8 million. Entertainment Film Distributors’ historical drama “The Uprising,” directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Andrew Garfield, opened in seventh position with $732,547.

	Studiocanal’s animated feature “Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom” landed in eighth place in its fourth session, collecting $665,849 to raise its total to $5.1 million. Warner Bros.’ Tom Cruise film “Digger” took ninth position in its sophomore frame, taking $661,819 to bring its cume to $3 million. Universal’s “The Odyssey,” directed by Christopher Nolan, rounded out the top 10 in its 13th week on release, adding $353,321 to push its cumulative gross to $118.3 million.
	

	Looking ahead to the upcoming theatrical frame, Monday saw Trafalgar Releasing launching music documentary “Always Lalisa,” followed on Tuesday by Cinematik presenting “ENB: The Sleeping Beauty” across 100+ locations.

	Wide commercial and saturation rollouts on Friday opening across 300+ locations are led by Disney’s survival thriller “Whalefall,” directed by Brian Duffield and starring Austin Abrams and Josh Brolin; Icon Film Distribution’s found-footage horror “The Influencer Project,” starring Chiara King; and Trafalgar Releasing’s filmed stage capture of “Hadestown: The Musical,” starring Reeve Carney and Eva Noblezada. Paramount is also rolling out “Street Fighter”.

	Mid-tier and platform releases across 100+ locations include Universal’s animated feature “Forgotten Island,” directed by Joel Crawford and Januel P. Mercado, and Anime Ltd.’s anime re-release “Arrietty,” featuring voice work from Saoirse Ronan and Tom Holland.

	Specialized, festival, and international titles arriving Friday include Conic’s drama “Case 137,” directed by Dominik Moll, across 25+ screens; Soilsiu Films’ documentary “Forever Is Now,” directed by Neasa Ní Chianáin, across 25+ sites; DOVC U.K.’s “Deadline,” directed by Kiwi Chow across 25+ screens; Central City Media’s “It’s My Time,” directed by Xue Bai and starring Michelle Yeoh across 25+ locations; Bulldog Film Distribution’s “By Design,” directed by Amanda Kramer and starring Juliette Lewis; Signature Entertainment’s “Winter of the Crow”; Exposure’s “Mistura”; Dogwoof’s “Naza”; and Bakrania Media’s “Prahaar.”

	Repertory and archival screenings are highlighted by Hammer and Icon Film Distribution launching Terence Fisher’s classic “Dracula” in a 4K restoration across 100+ screens, alongside Park Circus’ 25th anniversary 4K restoration of Alejandro Amenábar’s “The Others,” starring Nicole Kidman, across 100+ locations. The frame concludes on Saturday with Trafalgar Releasing’s live event cinema broadcast of the Metropolitan Opera’s “Macbeth”.

schema.headline: ‘Other Mommy’ Nips ‘Verity’ in Photo Finish for U.K., Ireland Box Office Summit

title: Vietnamese Franchise Sequel ‘Sister Sister 3’ Lands at 3388 Films for Americas, Europe, Australia, Taiwan and Japan (EXCLUSIVE)
description: Vietnamese female-led franchise entry “Sister Sister 3” has been picked up by U.S.-based specialty distributor 3388 Films for the Americas, Europe,
body:
Vietnamese female-led franchise entry “Sister Sister 3” has been picked up by U.S.-based specialty distributor 3388 Films for the Americas, Europe, Australia, Taiwan and Japan. 

	The deal was closed at the Asian Contents & Film Market (ACFM) in Busan.

	Directed by Nguyen Huu Hoang and produced by Will Vu for Muse Films, the film is the third chapter in one of Vietnam’s most recognized franchises built around women. Ninh Duong Lan Ngoc, Chi Pu and Ky Duyen head the cast, with Steven Nguyen and Quoc Anh also starring. The original Vietnamese title is “Chị Chị Em Em 3.”
	

	Set in northern Vietnam of a bygone era, the period piece draws its look from traditional Vietnamese culture. It reworks Thị Mầu, the free-spirited, flirtatious heroine of a classic Chèo play who defies Confucian norms and rebels against feudal prejudice. Chèo is a traditional Vietnamese form of popular musical theater.


	In the film, Thị Mầu is a gifted young beauty hemmed in by rigid custom and the demands of her family. Following her own heart pulls her into a tangle of romance, jealousy, hidden truths and forbidden relationships. As private longing collides with honor and social codes, each character has to reckon with what their choices cost.

	“We’re constantly seeking daring, character-driven stories that resonate with the global audience and 3388 Films is ecstatic to have acquired such a bold and brazen female-led film,” said Thien A. Pham, founder of 3388 Films.

	The film will open in Vietnamese cinemas at the end of October, with 3388 Films’ theatrical rollout across several continents set to follow later this year.
	

	“I’m very excited ‘Sister Sister 3’ will soon be seen by international audiences and proud to be able to share our film which showcases the beauty of traditional Vietnamese culture while telling a seductive and emotionally gripping story of love, desire, and secrets,” said Vu.

	3388 Films is a production and distribution company that prioritizes theatrical releases and has worked with Asian content for more than two decades, with experience across five continents. Its recent distribution slate includes “Mai,” which became the first Vietnamese film to gross more than $2 million at the combined North America and Europe box office. The company also produced the independent thriller-horror “Actress Wanted.”

schema.headline: Vietnamese Franchise Sequel ‘Sister Sister 3’ Lands at 3388 Films for Americas, Europe, Australia, Taiwan and Japan (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Bryan Cranston Mourns ‘Breaking Bad’ Son RJ Mitte: ‘I’ll Miss You, Son’
description:
Bryan Cranston shared a tribute to RJ Mitte, who played his son Walter White Jr. in “Breaking Bad,” following the news of his death at age 34.

	“I’
body:
Bryan Cranston shared a tribute to RJ Mitte, who played his son Walter White Jr. in “Breaking Bad,” following the news of his death at age 34.

	“I’m in deep despair as I write this tonight. RJ Mitte, my sweet son on Breaking Bad has died,” wrote Cranston. “I met him when he was only 14 years old when he was cast as Walter White Jr., a part he played with such joy and enthusiasm. Born with Cerebral Palsy, he never – ever – allowed that challenge to be an excuse for anything. He met the demanding shooting schedule head on with great determination.”
	

	Cranston continued: “Always listening to the advice that his TV parents (Anna Gunn and myself) gave him – but being a teenager, sometimes mischievously ignoring the counsel in order to learn the hard way… He was one of the stars of a hit TV show – but still a kid. That kid was pretty raw when we started shooting the pilot in February of 2007, but little by little we watched him grow into a really fine actor. He parlayed his experience on the show to be a vocal advocate for performers with disabilities, and was the head of a philanthropic organization with a focus on helping the disabled community. All that promise and potential now is such a loss.” 


	The actor also noted that Mitte’s cause of death was confirmed to be suicide. “It is especially devastating to hear that he took his own life,” he wrote. “Why? We were texting each other just a few weeks ago – figuring out when we could meet for lunch. I don’t know if that lunch would have changed his future… But I do know that I loved him, and thoroughly enjoyed being with him throughout the years on the series, and after the spotlight on Breaking Bad dimmed… I’ll miss you, son.” 
	

	Like his character in the series, Mitte had cerebral palsy, having received his diagnosis at age three. He was a prominent advocate for disabled people in Hollywood and beyond, serving as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children’s Hospitals as well as president of the Mitte Foundation, a Texas-based nonprofit founded by his family in 1994. In 2013, the year “Breaking Bad” ended, he won the SAG-AFTRA Harold Russell Award, which honors disabled actors for their efforts surrounding representation and awareness.

	Mitte was just 14 when he began working on “Breaking Bad” and appeared in 56 of the AMC series’ 62 episodes over the course of its five-season run from 2008 to 2013. His other credits include the recurring role of Campbell Bingman in Season 3 of the ABC Family drama “Switched at Birth” and the villain Mind Master in Netflix’s 2022 superhero series “The Guardians of Justice.” Just ahead of his death, he was actively promoting his role in the film “Talking to Strangers,” directed by Johnny Severin.

	Dean Norrie, who appeared on “Breaking Bad” as DEA agent Hank Schrader, wrote that he was “heartbroken” by the actor’s death. “Oh my God! Was working just found out about RJ,” he wrote on X Monday. “I am heartbroken. Though RJ didn’t play my TV son, I always looked out for him as a young kid on set. He was a sweetheart of a young man and will be greatly missed. This is so heartbreaking, I can’t believe it. Thinking of him and his family.”

schema.headline: Bryan Cranston Mourns ‘Breaking Bad’ Son RJ Mitte: ‘I’ll Miss You, Son’

title: Cannes Queer Animated Comedy ‘Jim Queen’ Scores New Sales at Busan (EXCLUSIVE)
description: Cannes animated comedy “Jim Queen” has picked up a new batch of international sales after screening at the Busan International Film Festival, its fi
body:
Cannes animated comedy “Jim Queen” has picked up a new batch of international sales after screening at the Busan International Film Festival, its first outing in Asia. 

	Global Constellation, the sales arm of pan-European studio Vuelta, has closed deals with Prorom for the Czech and Slovak Republics, Hungary, Romania and Bulgaria. HBO has secured first-window pay-TV and SVOD rights in Eastern Europe. Elsewhere, Folkets Bio has taken Sweden, AS Fidalgo has Norway and Films4You has Portugal, while CDI/LAT-E has acquired Argentina, Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay. A South Korean deal is now in negotiation.
	

	The new territories add to earlier sales to I Wonder Pictures (Italy), O’Brother (Benelux), Capelight Pictures (Germany), Praesens (Switzerland), Polyfilm (Austria), Elastica/Filmin (Spain), Lev Cinema (Israel), Madman (Australia and New Zealand), Photon Films (Canada), Pandora Filmes/Belas Artes Grupo (Brazil), Pimienta Films (Mexico) and Creative Century (Taiwan). Creative Century Distribution will open the film in Taiwanese cinemas on Oct. 23.


	For the U.S., Global Constellation is weighing several offers, with a release set for 2027. Jordan Firstman and Matteo Lane were recently unveiled as the English-language voices of Jim and Lucien.

	Set in Paris, the story centers on Jim, a gym-obsessed influencer and the most desired man on the city’s gay scene. His status collapses overnight when a strange virus called Heterosis begins converting gay men to heterosexuality. Dropped by his followers and shunned by his circle, Jim has only Lucien on his side, a skinny and fiercely loyal admirer. The pair head into the Marais in search of a renegade doctor who may hold a cure.
	

	The film world premiered at Cannes, where festival chief Thierry Frémaux called the screening “one of the most beautiful in the festival’s history in terms of atmosphere.” The Jokers Films opened it in France on June 17, and it entered the box office chart at No. 3 behind “Toy Story 5” and “Backrooms.” It has since passed 385,000 admissions there and taken more than $3 million.

	Reviewing the film for Variety, Guy Lodge wrote: “The humor and storytelling can be likened to ‘South Park’ in their senseless, fast-moving escalation toward absurdity, and the broadly cartoonish animation style – clean lines, popping eyes, flat expanses of color in ’80s mall-decor shades of pink, lilac and spearmint – is a running reminder of just how seriously to take the whole enterprise.”

	Nguyen and Athané, both Gobelins graduates, co-wrote the screenplay with Simon Balteaux and Brice Chevillard. Between them they have worked on series, games and features including “The Summit of the Gods,” “Ernest & Celestine,” “The Big Bad Fox and Other Tales,” “The Swallows of Kabul,” “The Rabbi’s Cat” and “The Red Turtle.”

	David Alric and Arthur Delabays produced for Paris-based adult animation outfit Bobbypills. The studio’s credits include James Gunn’s DC Studios series “Creature Commandos,” “Captain Laserhawk: A Blood Dragon Remix,” a Netflix series made in partnership with Ubisoft Film & Television, and the Netflix titles “Crisis Jung” and “Vermin.” Umedia (“The Count of Monte Cristo,” “The Night of the Zoocalypse”) co-produced, with backing from Eurimages, the CNC’s Avance sur recettes, the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, the Charente department and the Réunion region.

	Global Constellation was formed in 2025 by combining London’s Film Constellation with Munich-based Global Screen.

title: ‘Breaking Bad’ Star RJ Mitte’s Cause of Death Confirmed as Suicide
description:
RJ Mitte died by suicide, his rep has confirmed.

	Mitte died Monday at 34. He was best known for his role in the Vince Gilligan-created drama “Brea
body:
RJ Mitte died by suicide, his rep has confirmed.

	Mitte died Monday at 34. He was best known for his role in the Vince Gilligan-created drama “Breaking Bad,” in which he played Walter White Jr., the son of Walter White (Bryan Cranston) and Holly White (Anna Gunn). Like his “Breaking Bad” character Walt Jr., Mitte had cerebral palsy.

	The Brownsville Police Department received a call at 12:50 p.m. local time and found Mitte dead at his home, People reported. “The cause and manner of death are still pending, as there is currently an ongoing investigation,” the BPD.Mitte appeared in all five seasons of the show, which ran from 2008 to 2013. 
	

	“It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte,” his rep said in a statement earlier Monday. “Drawing from his own experience living with cerebral palsy, Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion.”

	After “Breaking Bad,” he had roles on “Switched at Birth,” “Robot Chicken,” “On Hiatus with Monty Geer,” “This Close,” “Now Apocalypse” and “The Guardians of Justice (Will Save You!)” among others. He also appeared in films including “Dixieland,” “Who’s Driving Doug,” “The Recall,” “Mower Boy,” “Time Share,” “The Oak Room” and more.

	Before starring on “Breaking Bad,” the actor appeared in short films including “Stump” and “Weird Science 2: Strange Chemistry,” as well as the film “House of Last Things.” At the time of his death, he had a handful of projects in pre-production and production phases, and was actively promoting his new movie, “Talking to Strangers.”

	If you or anyone you know is having thoughts of suicide, please call the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline by dialing 988 or go to SpeakingOfSuicide.com/resources.

schema.headline: ‘Breaking Bad’ Star RJ Mitte’s Cause of Death Confirmed as Suicide

title: Danny Trejo Had ‘Never Heard’ of Ben Shapiro Before Signing On for Daily Wire’s ‘Pawn Shop,’ Says His Son: ‘It’s F—d Up. He’s Handcuffed to This Stupid Project’
description: Danny Trejo, who sparked backlash after it was revealed he’d be starring in the pro-ICE movie “Pawn Shop” from Ben Shapiro’s production company, Dai
body:
Danny Trejo, who sparked backlash after it was revealed he’d be starring in the pro-ICE movie “Pawn Shop” from Ben Shapiro’s production company, Daily Wire, had “never heard” of the conservative political commentator and is contractually unable to say anything negative about Shapiro — or the project — his son, Gilbert Trejo, said.

	Gilbert shared a post to his Instagram story responding to the outcry from fans of the actor over the weekend, addressing claims that Danny is pro-ICE or supports Shapiro’s politics. He began by saying that only two weeks into shooting the project did any of the cast learn that Shapiro was involved, and that this father “has never heard of Ben Shapiro.” “I had to explain to him who that is, and what kind of guy he is,” wrote Gilbert.
	

	He went on to write that Danny is unable to “badmouth” Shapiro or the film contractually. He also can’t “walk away without being sued for breach of contract. He couldn’t even release the statement he wanted to.” (Danny had previously told TMZ that he is a “proud Mexican who has always been and will always be a supporter of my community. I am also obviously pro-immigrant. I am not pro-ICE.. I know where I come from and I know our struggles. I am an actor. My job is to tell a story.”)


	“It’s fucked up,” he continued. “He’s handcuffed to this stupid project, and swaths of people have instantly turned their back on him without knowing any of the facts.”

	He said his father’s agent described the film as a “complicated story about a complicated time, where everyone looks bad except you, the hardworking Mexican shop owner who just wants peace,” to which Danny “jumped” at the idea of playing “a good guy.”
	

	The logline for the film reads: “When a Minneapolis riot forces a young ICE officer to complete a high-stakes arrest alone after his partner is killed, he is hunted through the streets by a furious mob intent on freeing the prisoner and punishing anyone who still upholds the law. Barricaded inside a neighborhood pawn shop with a hard-edged Hispanic veteran and the man’s progressive college-age grandson, ordinary men must choose between the rule of law and the chaos that wants to burn it all down in a modern siege of honor and defiance.”

	Read Gilbert’s full statement here.

	For anyone seeing this shit with my dad…

	He was booked on a film, it’s not pro-ice, its not overtly pro anything. His agent described it as ‘a complicated story about a complicated time, where everyone looks bad except you, the hardworking Mexican shop owner who just wants peace.”

	He jumped at the idea of playing a good guy.

	About 2 weeks into shooting everyone, including us, found out Ben Shapiro was involved.

	My 82 year old dad has never heard of Ben Shapiro, I had to explain to him who that is, and what kind of guy he is.

	My dad contractually can’t badmouth him, the film, or walk away without being sued for breach of contract. He couldn’t even release the statement he wanted to.

	It’s fucked up. He’s handcuffed to this stupid project, and swaths of people have instantly turned their back on him without knowing any of the facts.

	Ben Shapiro got Mexicans to abandon one of their heroes, got his own name to the top of google searches, and made us look like angry fools lacking any nuance. He wins.

schema.headline: Danny Trejo Had ‘Never Heard’ of Ben Shapiro Before Signing On for Daily Wire’s ‘Pawn Shop,’ Says His Son: ‘It’s F—d Up. He’s Handcuffed to This Stupid Project’

	Golden Go
body:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission.

	Golden Goose is teaming up with Disney for a new Mickey & Friends collection, featuring the Italian luxury brand’s signature distressed sneakers alongside a lineup of apparel and accessories inspired by the iconic animated characters.

	Launching Oct. 13, the collaboration will also include a global customization tour, with Disney character artists visiting select Golden Goose stores around the world to offer personalized designs and interactive workshops.
	

	At the center of the collection is a special-edition take on Golden Goose’s popular Super-Star sneaker, reimagined in vintage-inspired gray suede with a white leather star and Mickey Mouse graphics. Available in men’s, women’s and kids’ sizes, the sneaker joins a lineup of oversized reversible bomber jackets, distressed sweatshirts, graphic T-shirts, polos, baseball caps and children’s apparel featuring Disney’s iconic characters.


		

						
			
	

	
					
		

										LIMITED-EDITION						

					Super-Star Sneaker		

		
	

	The collection also includes Disney-themed patches, pins, charms and embellished laces, allowing shoppers to put their own spin on the designs. Through Golden Goose’s signature Co-Creation experience, customers can further customize select pieces with screen-printed Disney graphics.

	The collaboration extends beyond the merchandise with a worldwide Co-Creation tour featuring Disney character artists and Golden Goose’s in-house artisans, known as Dream Makers. During the in-store events, Disney artists will personalize Golden Goose products with character designs and create live Mickey & Friends illustrations on co-branded cards for guests to take home.

	Fans can also take part in Disney-inspired workshops, including creating Mickey Mouse ears, coloring comic-book illustrations and designing custom keychains. A special co-branded Mickey & Friends balloon will also be available as a gift.
	

	The tour kicks off Oct. 14 at Golden Goose’s South Coast Plaza store in Orange County, Calif., before making stops in New York, Orlando, Miami, Mexico City, Milan, Paris, London, Shanghai, Tokyo, Seoul and other cities through early December.

	The partnership marks another high-fashion outing for Mickey Mouse, who has become a recurring fixture in luxury fashion collaborations as Disney continues to bring its most recognizable characters into the worlds of designer apparel and streetwear. 

	The Disney x Golden Goose collection will be available beginning Oct. 13 at GoldenGoose.com and select stores worldwide. Fans can find the full schedule of Co-Creation events and registration details on the brand’s official Disney collaboration page.

schema.headline: Golden Goose Teams With Disney for Mickey Mouse-Inspired Sneakers, Apparel and Global Customization Tour

Six Flags Over Georgia
                          Man Dies After Falling Off Coaster
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              
                October 12, 2026
                
                            3:06 PM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  October 12, 2026
                                3:54 PM PDT
                                    
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Tragedy at Six Flags Over Georgia ... a man was riding the popular Goliath ride when he fell to his death.
      
    
            According to local reports, park guests saw the man's gruesome death ... he reportedly hit the tracks multiple times as he fell ... and the fall was even captured in souvenir photos.
      
    
            Four others were injured. It's unclear how the man fell from the ride.
      

            Goliath is stopped on the tracks ... and riders are being evacuated four at a time. 
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Six Flags Over Georgia confirmed the incident in a statement ... "We are deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today. Our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest's family, friends, and loved ones."
      
    
            The theme park says it is "providing support to the guests and team members affected" ... and working with local law enforcement. 
      
    
            Six Flags adds ... "Out of respect for the family's privacy, we will not be sharing additional details at this time."
      
    
            The man has not been identified.

title: RJ Mitte Was 'So Positive' Weeks Before He Died by Suicide
description:
RJ Mitte
                          Was Looking Ahead to Future Projects
body:
RJ Mitte
                          Was Looking Ahead to Future Projects
                          ... Before He Died By Suicide
                      
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            RJ Mitte was making plans for the future and talking about new movies and philanthropy just weeks before his death ... according to podcast host Joe Vulpis, who tells TMZ he was stunned to learn RJ was dead.
      
    
            Joe tells TMZ ... he filmed an episode of "The Joe Vulpis Podcast" with the late "Breaking Bad" star about two weeks ago ... describing RJ as "so positive" and "one of the most kind and genuine people [he] got to speak with." 
      
    
            The podcast host tells TMZ ... "His passing is super surprising because he was so grounded and down to earth."
      
    
            Joe says RJ was deeply committed to his philanthropic work and was passionate about giving back.
      

                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Joe says the two spent additional time together after recording, talking about life and what was coming next. He tells us he specifically asked RJ what he had on the horizon ... and the "Breaking Bad" star told him he was focused on continuing his charitable efforts while working on movies and television projects.
      
    
            RJ also told Joe he'd just signed on for another movie and was promoting his project "Talking to Strangers."
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            RJ's podcast episode was released October 5, and a clip from the conversation was among his recent social media posts. During the interview, the actor reflected on his years playing Walter White Jr. on "Breaking Bad" and its lasting impact.
      
    
            RJ was also known for his advocacy and philanthropy, particularly his work supporting people with disabilities.
      
    
            We broke the story ... RJ died by suicide in his Texas home on Monday. Law enforcement says the investigation is ongoing, and further details have not been publicly disclosed.
      
    
            If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988 or chat 988lifeline.org.
